name: tri6fm1
author: Fergus
tagline: a Trigon-6 style polysynth for the FM-1
description: A six-voice polysynth in the style of the Sequential Trigon-6: three oscillators a voice with sync, noise, feedback and drive into a 2/4-pole ladder filter, two envelopes, an LFO, poly mod, vintage, distortion, two effects, an eight-slot mod matrix, unison with chord memory and an arpeggiator.
credits: Built on fm1-base and felucca-bsp. Unofficial: not affiliated with Sequential or M-VAVE.
